brief:
American officials report that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently held meetings with representatives from the United Arab Emirates. The discussions centered on regional security concerns, particularly regarding Iran's activities and influence in the Middle East, according to Ma'an news agency.

The two countries have maintained diplomatic ties since formalizing relations in 2020 under the Abraham Accords. The meetings reflect their continued coordination on strategic matters affecting the Gulf region.
title: Netanyahu meets UAE officials amid warnings over Iran
